# Caramelo

> Open, politically-neutral data layer for Brazilian public data: parliamentary
> amendments (emendas, including emendas Pix), roll-call votes, parliamentary
> expenses (CEAP), municipal budgets (SICONFI), municipality dimensions (IBGE),
> politicians' declared social accounts, and news-coverage snapshots — all
> normalized to Parquet, republished with content-hash manifests, and diffed
> into typed webhook events.

All data is served from a public R2 bucket with free egress. Tables are plain
Parquet, queryable directly over HTTP (DuckDB: `SELECT * FROM
'https://data.caramelo.dev.br/latest/emendas.parquet'`).
Person-level entity resolution links emenda authors to Câmara/Senado ids
(99.2% of 2021+ individual-emenda paid value resolved).

## Data

- [Manifest (JSON)](https://data.caramelo.dev.br/latest/manifest.json): current tables, row counts, sha256 content hashes, generation timestamp
- [Data documentation (Markdown)](/docs/data.md): every table, its columns, source, and update cadence
- [Events documentation (Markdown)](/docs/events.md): event taxonomy and webhook subscription API

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/gabriel-laet/caramelo): harvesters, entity resolution, publish pipeline, Cloudflare deploy — MIT licensed
- [Architecture (Markdown)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabriel-laet/caramelo/main/ARCHITECTURE.md)
- [Verified source research (Markdown)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/gabriel-laet/caramelo/main/RESEARCH.md)

## API and MCP

- [REST API](https://api.caramelo.dev.br/docs): read-only typed endpoints
  over the lake (rankings, profiles, municipality views, search). OpenAPI at
  https://api.caramelo.dev.br/openapi.json
- **MCP server**: `https://mcp.caramelo.dev.br/` (Streamable HTTP transport,
  no auth). Tools mirror the REST endpoints 1:1: `emendas_autores`,
  `emendas_municipio`, `pix_per_capita`, `politico`, `governismo`,
  `municipio`, `busca`.

## Optional

- Upstream sources: Portal da Transparência (emendas bulk), Câmara dos
  Deputados Dados Abertos (votes, expenses, profiles), Senado Federal,
  Tesouro Nacional SICONFI, IBGE, SearchApi.io (news snapshots)
